I've set up the "Strategic pod brief" to run every morning at 07:45 Chicago time (12:45 UTC while on CDT). It will summarise new messages in #strategic-pod, #strategic-random and #inc-vtg-hartford and post the result to #strategic-random, with finance figures left out. I also replied in #strategic-random to confirm.

Three things need attention:

- **Not active yet.** The Hermes gateway isn't running on this host, so the job won't fire until someone starts it (`hermes gateway start`).
- **Clock mismatch.** The simulation clock says 14 Oct, but the host clock says 25 Oct. The job uses the host clock, so its first run will be on the host's next 07:45, not 15 Oct. My reply in the channel mentioned this, but the wording was muddled.
- **Delivery is unverified.** The job is set to save its output locally and rely on the job itself to post via the world tools. I haven't confirmed that a fired run can post, so check the first brief after the gateway is up.

Job ID: 0f436e826a95, which you can pause or remove with cronjob_manage.
